overview.envNotDetected: Not detected yet. Click refresh to scan Python, venv, and Git.
overview.label: Overview

results.intro: Browse outputs by type — recorded on runs, or discovered in the working directory.
results.declaredHint: Expand a run to see its outputs. Figures prefer frozen copies; shared working paths appear only under the newest declaring run.
results.declaredEmpty: No artifacts recorded on runs yet.
results.supersededPaths: {{count}} declared working path(s) superseded by a newer run
results.discoveredHint: Read-only scan of figures, tables, and metrics — not the same as run bookkeeping.
results.discoveredEmpty: No figures, tables, or metrics found yet.

empty.noFolderDesc: Add a folder in Settings → Workspace and set its type to Experiments root. Each experiment gets a subfolder there for code and results. Run history is kept automatically by the app.
empty.noExperimentsDesc: Create one here, or ask the Agent in chat (it can link your research brief).
empty.noArchived: No archived experiments in this view.
empty.noArchivedDesc: You are viewing archived experiments only. Archive an experiment from its detail menu (⋯ → Archive), or switch back to active experiments.
empty.corruptOne: 1 experiment has corrupt or missing metadata and was skipped.
empty.corruptMany: {{count}} experiments have corrupt or missing metadata and were skipped.

toolbar.openLabTitle: Open this experiment’s working directory in Files

sidebar.hint: Open an experiment from the list — each one opens as its own tab. Overview and Environment for the active tab appear here.
sidebar.emptyList: No experiments yet. Use New experiment in the toolbar.

content.pickFromSidebarDesc: Choose one from the sidebar list. Each opens as its own tab so you can keep several open.

detail.deleteBody: Removes “{{title}}” and its run history from the project. This cannot be undone.

brief.placeholder: No hypothesis, research question, or linked brief sections yet.
brief.editDesc: Hypothesis, research question, and linked research-brief sections for this experiment.
brief.rqPlaceholder: The research question this experiment addresses…
brief.sectionsHint: Pick from this project's Research Brief canonical sections.
brief.openBriefHint: Open the project Research Brief as a file
brief.openSectionHint: Open the brief file and jump to “{{section}}”
brief.openFailed: Could not open the Research Brief
brief.fillDone: Filled excerpts from the Research Brief
brief.fillEmpty: Research Brief has no Research question or Hypotheses text yet
brief.fillFailed: Could not read the Research Brief

create.title: New experiment
create.desc: Creates a working directory under your experiments workspace root and starts an empty run history. Optionally add tags and research links.

runPanel.dialogDesc: Runs in this experiment’s working directory and is recorded in history.
runPanel.confirmTimeout: Confirm timed out — run not started
runPanel.permissionReadonly: Permission mode is read-only — runs are disabled.
runPanel.selectExperiment: Select an experiment to run a command.
runPanel.runInProgress: A run is in progress for this experiment.
runPanel.populateLast: Populate from the most recent run

runConfirm.title: Confirm experiment run
runConfirm.body: This will execute a shell command in the experiment’s working directory. The run is recorded with the current environment snapshot.

runs.enterCommandHint: Use Run in the toolbar, or ask the Agent in chat.
runs.notePlaceholder: Add a note for this run…
runs.citeAddedOne: Added to Chat — Send to draft Methods & figures
runs.noOutput: No output, artifacts, or notes for this run.
runs.selectRunHint: Select a run to view output, artifacts, and actions.
runs.sendToChat: Send this run to Chat with Methods / figure scaffolding
runs.workingCopyNewer: Working file(s) were updated after this run — preview below is the frozen snapshot from this run.

compare.hint: Compare selected runs side by side
compare.title: Compare runs
compare.metricsHint: Metrics come from JSON artifacts listed on each run (e.g. metrics.json). If the working-copy file was overwritten by a later run, values may not be that run’s frozen snapshot.

provenance.title: Artifact provenance
provenance.desc: Trace this file back to the run that produced it.
provenance.noRun: No run recorded for this file — it may have been copied manually.
provenance.sendArtifact: Send this run + artifact to chat
provenance.sendDraft: Send this run to Chat for manuscript drafting
